## <h2> Title 3: Code and Syntax Highlighting

### Inline Code
To configure settings, update the `config.theme` property in your local file.

### Block Code (JavaScript)
```javascript
// Test JavaScript syntax highlighting
const user = {
  name: "Alex",
  role: "Administrator",
  isActive: true
};

function checkStatus(account) {
  if (account.isActive) {
    console.log(`Welcome back, ${account.name}!`);
  } else {
    console.log("Account is deactivated.");
  }
}

checkStatus(user);
```

### Block Code (Python)
```python
# Test Python syntax highlighting
def calculate_factorial(n):
    if n == 0 or n == 1:
        return 1
    else:
        return n * calculate_factorial(n - 1)

print(f"Factorial of 5 is: {calculate_factorial(5)}")
```
